name: PhronexusAI – Free Advertising & Banner Exchange
author: Eduard Pepushaj

sections.description:
PhronexusAI is a free banner exchange and B2B cross-promotion network. Your site shows ads from complementary businesses, and your business appears on theirs, so you get free advertising in front of a relevant audience. AI matches you with relevant partners and always blocks your competitors. You approve which ads can appear on your site.

This plugin connects your WordPress site to your PhronexusAI account without touching your theme files:

  • Ad space: paste your ad space key and partner ads appear on your site.
  • Conversion tracking (optional): paste your tracking key to count sign-ups, sales or other conversions that come from your PhronexusAI ads.
  • Works on every page of your site, with any theme.
  • No coding, no editing of footer.php.

You need a free PhronexusAI account to get your keys: phronexusai.com

External services

This plugin connects your site to the PhronexusAI service, which is required for it to work.

  • What is loaded: when you add a key, the plugin loads https://phronexusai.com/phronexusai.js (ad space) and/or https://phronexusai.com/phronexus-track.js (conversion tracking) on the public pages of your site. Nothing is loaded until you save a key.
  • What is sent: when a visitor views a page, the scripts send your key, the page address, the ad impressions and clicks, and (if tracking is enabled) conversion events to phronexusai.com, so that partner ads can be shown and results can be measured in your dashboard.
  • Provider: PhronexusAI – Terms of Service, Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from Plugins → Add New (search “PhronexusAI”), or upload the phronexusai folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Settings → PhronexusAI.
  4. In your PhronexusAI dashboard, open Connection and copy the value of data-key from your ad space code. Paste it into Ad space key.
  5. (Optional) Copy the data-key from your conversion tracking code and paste it into Conversion tracking key.
  6. Click Save Changes, then click Verify connection in your PhronexusAI dashboard.
sections.faq:
Is PhronexusAI free?

Yes. The Free plan is free forever, with no credit card. A Premium plan is available for higher daily limits and unlimited AI ad creation.

Will my competitors’ ads appear on my site?

No. Competitors are always blocked from matching, and you approve the ads that can appear on your site.

I have more than one ad space.

Add one key per line in the Ad space key field.

How do I remove the code?

Clear the keys and save, or deactivate the plugin. Deleting the plugin also removes its settings.
